Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Note 1 - 


-The lengths shall be chosen from Series 1 as far as possible. Incase these lengths are not sufficient. 


these shall be taken from Series 2 or 3. 


Note 2 — Details not specified shall be suitably chosen. 


Note 3 — For details regarding connecting dimensions, fits and dimension combinations of hands for clocks. 


IS : 12472-1988 'Connecting dimensions, fits and dimension combinations of hands for clock', shall be referred. 


EXPLANATORY NOTE 


This standard is one of a series of Indian Standards relating to clocks. 


The numbers in Series 1 are ternris of a decimal geometric series and correspond with the rounded 


numbers of the preferred numbers series RIO and the value of the Series 2 are taken from the preferred 


number series R20 of IS : 1076-1967 Preferred numbers'. 


Successive numbers of Series 1 are stepped with the ratio 1 : 1*25 ( up to 1 : 1*18). This ratio 


corresponds to an usual combination of hour and minutes hands. In the preparation of this standard. 


assistance has been derived from DIN 8270/2-1966 'Hands for clocks, lengths', issued by the 


Deutsches Institut fur Normung ( DIN ). 


Adopted 3 August 1988
